result.brief: 提出 ALPS 视觉状态编码器，用语言对齐、像素重建与跨视角自蒸馏联合预训练 ViT，使单一 patch 表征同时支持世界模型预测、指令跟随与可视化检查。
result.reason: Pretrains a visual state encoder (ViT) unifying language alignment, reconstruction and cross-view self-distillation for world models; a representation contribution, not merely using an encoder as baseline.
